1729388988847459814.description:
Formulated with x5 powerhouse ingredients - Glutathione, Kojic Acid, Alpha Arbutin, Licorice, and Papaya Extract that deliver fast power whitening results.
Glutathione- renowned for its depigmenting property, Glutathione is in the limelight for getting lighter, brighter, and more radiant
skin.
Kojic Acid – lightens the skin, which can improve the appearance of age spots and sun damage.
Alpha Arbutin - is a molecule extracted from the bearberry plant that prevents the formation of melanin. It Lightens dark spots, lessens the appearance of acne scars, and helps even out skin tone.
Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract - has a component called glabridin that plays a vital role in inhibiting tyrosinase activity and therefore provides skin-brightening effects.
Carica Papaya (Papaya) Fruit Extract - Its natural and effective exfoliating properties brighten the skin by removing dead skin cells.
Directions for use
Lather on the body and massage for a least 2 minutes. Rinse thoroughly with water.
Ingredients
Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Sodium Hydroxide, Sodium Lactate, Glutathione, Kojic Acid, Alpha Arbutin, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Carica Papaya (Papaya) Fruit Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Fragrance
